notes: BM-02: fetches title+favicon but not description or preview image. BM-04: edit covers title/description/tags only, no url editing, and there is no separate note field. BM-06: no duplicate-url check exists in the create endpoint (README even lists de-dup as a 'next step'); import dedup does not count for this per-save requirement. BM-10: tag inputs are plain comma-separated text fields, no autocomplete. BM-12: FTS covers title/url/description/tags but there is no note field to search. BM-14: no #tag search syntax in the query box; tag filtering is a separate UI control/param, not parsed from search text. BM-15: _fts_query ANDs whitespace-split tokens with no boolean/paren support. BM-16: quoted phrases are split into separate escaped prefix tokens, breaking exact-phrase matching. BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag or view exists. BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk-action UI/API. BM-22: list is always relevance- or created_at-ordered, no user-selectable sort. BM-23: no markdown note field/rendering (the 'Notes' textarea maps to plain description). BM-24/25: no snapshot (local HTML/PDF or Internet Archive) capture. BM-26/27/28: no archived flag, no archive/unarchive, no archive view. BM-29: no bundle entity or saved-filter feature. BM-30: Netscape import preserves title and tags (folder + TAGS attr) but does not parse/preserve ADD_DATE. BM-31: no export endpoint or UI exists. BM-32: no user-settings entity or UI (sort/page-size/font-size) exists.
